messages.author: 4f18ec6c30746f23
messages.subject: Project to the past
parts: Do you know how can I project a model that I get using Wallace, to the past, using layers that I already get?

messages.author: 9960d2c790775b98
messages.subject: Project to the past
parts: Run the analysis you want with all the settings you plan to use and do a projection to the future in the extent you want to project to the past. After you get your projection get the code as an R markdown. Go in and swap the future data with your past data. That's how I've been doing it at least.

messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: Project to the past
parts:
Justin, thanks for providing a great answer. Alejandro, yes, that is the only way to make past projections in Wallace currently. If you need assistance with customizing the RMarkdown code, please ask.

The reason we can only offer future projections is because you cannot currently access the past climate layers in Worldclim through the raster package. We have been talking about writing some custom functions to pull the data off the Worldclim server, but have not implemented this yet. If code happens to arise that does this in the iterim, we'd love to include it to provide this functionality.
